map.指导孕妇自我监测胎动，识别胎儿宫内缺氧预警: Guide pregnant women to self-monitor fetal movement and recognize warning signs of intrauterine hypoxia
map.📖 查看「胎动计数(12小时)正常值器 使用指南」: 📖 View "Fetal Movement Count (12-hour) Normal-Value Tool User Guide"
map.每日早/中/晚各取1小时左侧卧位计数胎动，三次之和×4 = 12小时胎动数: Count 1 hour each morning/noon/evening in left lateral position; sum x4 = 12-hour count
map.采用 Cardiff 计数法：累计三段肾动后拓展至 12 小时估算，超过阈值提示: Using the Cardiff method: accumulate three segments then extend to 12h; exceeding threshold warns of fetal status.
map.任意取1小时安静状态下计数胎动: Count movements in any 1 quiet hour
map.一般28周后开始规律计数胎动: Generally start regular counting after 28 weeks
map.左侧卧位、安静环境、专注计数: Left lateral, quiet environment, focused counting
map.连续动作算1次，间隔后再次动算第2次: Continuous motions count as 1; a later motion after a gap counts as the 2nd
map.妊娠期高血压、糖尿病、胎儿生长受限等应加强监测: Preeclampsia, diabetes, FGR, etc. need intensified monitoring
map.12小时<20次或较平时减少≥50%，提示可能胎儿宫内缺氧。应立即左侧卧位、饮水: <20 in 12h or >=50% drop vs usual suggests possible fetal hypoxia. Immediately lie left, drink water, recount 1h; if still abnormal, seek care for NST.
map.可能为脐带受压或胎盘早剥等急性缺氧，属紧急情况，应立即急诊就医。: May indicate acute hypoxia (cord compression, abruption); emergency—go to ER at once.
map.提示：胎动是胎儿宫内安危的\"报警器\"。每个胎儿胎动规律不同，重点是与平时对比: Tip: fetal movement is the "alarm" of fetal well-being. Each fetus has its own pattern; compare with the usual. For maternal self-monitoring only; seek care if abnormal, not a substitute for diagnosis.
map.孕 28 周后孕妇每日数胎动，监测胎儿宫内状态。: After 28 weeks, count movements daily to monitor fetal status.
map.胎动明显减少时及时就诊。: Seek care promptly when movements clearly decrease.
map.高危妊娠（妊高症、FGR）加强监测。: High-risk pregnancies (preeclampsia, FGR) need intensified monitoring.
map.固定 2 小时内数到 12 次胎动，≥10 次为正常，提示胎儿状态良好。: In a fixed 2 hours count 12 movements; >=10 is normal, indicating good fetal status.
map.平时 2 小时约 15 次，今日仅 3 次且持续偏弱，低于 10 次警戒线，建议: Usually ~15 in 2h; today only 3 and persistently weak, below the 10-line; recheck in left lateral, if still low needs NST.
map.数胎动的标准是什么？: What is the standard for counting?
map.常用「2 小时≥10 次」或「12 小时≥30 次」；重点看自身规律变化，较绝对: Commonly ">=10 in 2h" or ">=30 in 12h"; the key is change from one's own baseline, more reliable than absolute values.
map.胎动少一定是缺氧吗？: Does fewer movements always mean hypoxia?
map.不一定，可能与母体活动、血糖、服药有关；但明显减少（降幅 >50%）或持续减弱应: Not necessarily—may relate to maternal activity, glucose, medication; but marked decrease (>50%) or persistent weakening needs evaluation for distress.
